title: Build a job from a ticket with filtered dependencies
prompt: Edit src/job.mjs so that it exports toJob(ticket, inSet). The ticket is an object with a string id, a string title and an array dependsOn of ticket ids. inSet is a Set of ticket ids. toJob returns a new object with id and title copied from the ticket. If at least one dependency in dependsOn is also in inSet, the object gets an after property holding those dependencies that are in inSet, in their original order, and no others. Dependencies that are not in inSet are dropped from after. When no dependency is in inSet, or dependsOn is empty, the returned object must not have an after property at all, not even an empty one. The ticket and its dependsOn array must not be modified. Keep the existing export name and do not add any dependencies.
